# Big Integer

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/big-integer` (default export). Primitive arbitrary-precision integer (serialized as a string so no precision is lost beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER).

## Usage
```ts
import BigIntegerField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/big-integer';
```

Example: value `"9007199254740993"`
